summary: Pricing card with a monthly and yearly toggle; the price rolls to the new number while a bright edge wipes through the dot grid behind it.

attributes.name: monthly
attributes.description: Price per month on monthly billing.

attributes.name: yearly
attributes.description: Price per month on yearly billing. The note under the price shows twelve times this value.

attributes.name: period
attributes.description: Initial billing period. Any value other than `monthly` selects yearly.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Currency symbol placed before the price.

attributes.name: features
attributes.default: Ultracode and multi-agent workflows|Priority access at peak times|Projects with shared context

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the user switches billing period. `price` is the per-month price for that period.

properties.name: price
properties.description: Per-month price for the selected period, read from `monthly` or `yearly`.

keyboard.action: On the billing toggle: select the other period and move focus to it.

accessibility: The billing toggle is a `role="radiogroup"` labelled `Billing period`, with two native buttons carrying `role="radio"` and `aria-checked`. Only the selected button is in the tab order; the arrow keys switch periods.

The price is text in the monospace font with tabular figures. The price row (rolling price, `/ month` and the dot canvas) is `aria-hidden`; a visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` region carries the price and period instead, for example `€16 per month, billed yearly`.
motion: With reduced motion the price and the billing note swap without rolling and the grid shows no wipe.
notes: The `−20%` badge on Yearly is fixed text and is not computed from `monthly` and `yearly`.
Whole prices show without decimals (`€16`), others with two (`€16.50`); the yearly total is rounded to cents.
The call to action is a nested `<hf-button>` labelled `Start free trial` with no handler; its clicks bubble out of the host. `hf-pricing` imports `hf-button` itself.
Attributes are read on first connect and are not observed; `monthly`, `yearly` and `currency` are re-read when the period changes.

data.note: The `−20%` badge on Yearly is fixed text, not computed; plan, prices, currency and features can be set.
